title: gate add and precheck warn of a gate that asks only an implementation detail, so planning settles it in the goal
goal: gate add prints detail only beside a gate that asks only an implementation detail (columns, caps, fields, units, a format, a layout, defaults, a name, one file or two, where something lives or appears) and has no reason to block; precheck SP prints the same line for each unanswered such gate of a committed item; skills/sprint/SKILL.md plan step 6 tells the planner to settle such a choice in the item's goal before the start gate
